new_action_semantics.native_default: No command submitted. It declares no physical next edge and no executed R1 update. The native scorer/shield determines actual next and it must be retained. This is a NEW policy, never reclassification of a rejected prior command.
new_action_semantics.preferences: Actual fresh source-local native route command; projected wire acceptance and later shield/ranking are separate. Delivered updated ACK does not reserve receiving capacity; actual edge remains mandatory.

finite_domain.empty_windows: all four original public-duration windows, unchanged and supplied to both initial families
finite_domain.fixed_initial_reference: both native_default and prefer_2 families retain all four E windows and the same future rolling action domain/information; a reference may not be silently constrained to one window or old forced-next semantics
finite_domain.native_branch_budget: not admitted; freeze only after corrected full public projection and independent review

implemented_scope.public_route_preference_model: conditional command execution, shield-gated preference ranking and bounded submission guard; supplied base S4 scores/calendar fields required
implemented_scope.public_executable_preference_actions: 32-candidate action vocabulary and explicit current-prefix command/no-command materialization; supplied public interval provenance required

next_derivation.initial_prefer2: At loaded L node0 public load_complete + source service gives earliest dispatch bound; target2 has only incoming0, all other declared finite jobs cannot reach0/2 before their goals, and current full occupancy must be0. Need explicit known initial/no-prior-edge proof for headway/calendar before using this as interval bound. Wire time must be strictly before dispatch; preserve native 0.01 rather than shorten it.
next_derivation.later_prefer8: At first-reuse L node7, target8 has only incoming7; E terminates at4 and P at9, with export disabled there, so no other allowed finite policy tray can use7to8. Need actual five-job state/terminal receipts, no prior reuse1 edge, no unresolved actions, current occupancy and public service timing. Return a conditional bound, never infer actual future truth.
next_derivation.native_default: Full S4 base score includes static service-aware potential, corridor/target calendar wait, pressure, history and tie ordering. Must reproduce this public model before evaluating default. Do not substitute best-allowed or old forced-wait code.
next_derivation.evidence_validation: Apply corrected model to the entire frozen saved domain/120 endpoint inputs, not only successful routes; record prediction error and unknowns before any new native campaign.

falsifiable_tests: If own current prefix already committed, no command may be submitted against it.
If a target occupancy or entry-headway/calendar bound is unknown, preference remains unknown, not default-success.
If a competitor can reserve the target between wire execution and dispatch, the primitive must allow updated ACK plus different actual next.
Full five-job zero-regression must be assessed on completed native outcomes against every declared fixed-initial reference; unfinished remains unknown.
